scope: Operational preflight and immutable correction audit for splitting global frames 398-486
summary: Four non-model preflight attempts failed without changing accepted pixels; each was corrected in a new command and preserved in the audit trail.
evidence: The first local storyboard command failed because the installed FFmpeg has no drawtext filter; the retry omitted labels and produced the review board.
The first rsync started before the remote parent existed and partially failed; the parent was created and rsync resumed without overwriting an experiment.
The first parallel tracking shell backgrounded the preceding cd because of shell operator precedence; the corrected command uses cd; command & and both tracks completed.
The first temporal-repair launch found a pre-created empty output directory and refused to overwrite it; the exact empty directory was removed with rmdir and the immutable rerun completed.
lessons: Review-board generation must not assume optional FFmpeg filters.
Parallel remote commands need an explicit working-directory statement before any background operator.
Experiment writers that refuse overwrite must own directory creation.
limitations: This record is operational evidence only and does not accept any video candidate.
next_actions: Use the corrected commands and the two 45-frame overlap windows for the strict gate.
